title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
description: Cisco is investigating the impact of an emergency distrust of eMudhra root and intermediate certificate authorities on its product line. The advisory lists numerous Cisco products under active investigation to determine if they are affected. As of now, no specific affected versions or confirmed vulnerabilities have been identified. Cisco will update the advisory as the investigation progresses.
